name: Stackup symmetry (warpage balance)
description: A layer stackup that is not symmetric about the board mid-plane warps on reflow. Fabs reject or re-quote asymmetric builds. Requires a design-data stackup (ordered layers with thicknesses); not evaluable from bare Gerbers.
what_it_measures: Maximum thickness mismatch between layers mirrored about the board mid-plane (0 when the stackup is symmetric).
